pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with varying pigment saturation. Edges exhibit smooth to moderately sharp pixel gradients. Spatial area of patches is heterogeneous, with smaller, more densely packed geometries concentrated along the dorsal ridge and larger, more expansive geometries on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily trifurcated. Pathway width is variable, exhibiting wider pixel thickness on the lower flank and hindquarters compared to the compressed pathways near the mane.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck and shoulder. The mane presents as a continuous jagged line against the background with softened edge definition.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct anatomical depression is visible at the base of the neck, creating a structural break in the continuity of the dorsal ridge profile.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized cluster of small, dark, punctate disruptions is visible on the lower-central flank, suggesting a series of small scars or parasitic lesions.
